verdict.rationale: Skyvern's SDK connects to its cloud Chromium over CDP and layers Playwright on top, so developers drive the cloud browser with Playwright plus AI actions and can fall back to selectors. That suggests Playwright-style code can run against Skyvern's browsers. However, nothing documents exposing a raw CDP/WebSocket endpoint that existing Puppeteer or generic CDP clients can attach to unchanged. missing for 10: documented CDP connect URL for external clients, Puppeteer compatibility, evidence that existing Playwright scripts run without rewriting, independent hands-on corroboration.
